title: Xbox goes down. You can't play games you own on disc
titleZh: Xbox 出现故障。您无法玩您在光盘上拥有的游戏
author: surprisetalk
relevanceReason: 命中 3 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: Jay Peters: Xbox’s huge outage even blocked games on discAn extended Xbox outage that began Sunday evening hasn’t just caused issues for people trying to play digital games — it blocked people from playing their disc-based games, too.When Sony announced that they were discontinuing physical discs for PlayStation, I was less outraged than many. The reason I felt this way wasn't because I loved what Sony was doing. I think it came from an understanding that physical media ain't what it used to be.I got an analog pocket a couple years ago, and I think it's an awesome product. I was able to insert my Game Boy cartridges from 20 years ago and was able to play them immediately, just like I did back then. Well, on a backlit screen with 10x the pixel density, but still.The impression I get is that a lot of people have this vision in their head for what physical media still is today, and it simply isn't. Sure, I technically didn't own Golden Sun on the GBA. I technically had a license, but for all intents and purposes, I owned that game. And the evidence is, without Nintendo authorizing anything, I'm able to play it on a new piece of hardware, and it works great. No network downtime is gonna prevent me from doing that.But owning a game on a disc today isn't really the same thing. It's still just a license, and Microsoft, Sony, and Nintendo can either intentionally or, in this case, unintentionally prevent you from playing that game, even if you own the physical copy. This isn't even to mention the fact that when you pop the disc in your drive, you're not playing from the disc. It's installing it to your internal hard drive and is probably installing a bunch of updates that are required to make the game actually work at all.All I'm saying is it's all digital on the PC side of things, and has been for ages, but we have means of maintaining access to the games we love over here, and it's one of the reasons I've gravitated to the PC for quite a while now.

comments.author: mawadev
comments.textRawHtml:
I wanted to show my gf the halo 1 campaign, so I downloaded the 30GB Masterchief Collection via steam. When I launched it, I was greeted with a black box. After 1 Minute it was a microsoft login screen that looked eerily like a browser inside the game. Since I couldn't do anything else, the game was stuck at a sub 720p resolution. I said fine Ill just create an account. Yea so mail, firstname, lastname, birthday, country, email and email verification code later I had to do captcha which is clicking and holding down a button. "Help us against the bots" it said. I unironically spent 5 minutes clicking that button, then being stuck in a loop with "please try again" while my gf just sat there watching me.

Well I turned off MCC and gave up.

I don't want to know what life is like having xbox hardware
comments.textZhHtml:
我想向我的女朋友展示光环 1 战役，所以我通过 steam 下载了 30GB 的 Masterchief Collection。当我启动它时，迎接我的是一个黑匣子。一分钟后，出现了一个微软登录屏幕，看起来奇怪地像游戏中的浏览器。由于我无能为力，游戏的分辨率一直停留在低于 720p 的水平。我说好吧，我就创建一个帐户。是的，所以邮件、名字、姓氏、生日、国家/地区、电子邮件和电子邮件验证码稍后我必须执行验证码，即单击并按住按钮。它说：“帮助我们对抗机器人”。讽刺的是，我花了 5 分钟点击该按钮，然后陷入了“请重试”的循环，而我的女朋友只是坐在那里看着我。

好吧，我关掉了 MCC 并放弃了。

我不想知道拥有 Xbox 硬件的生活是什么样的

children.author: epistasis
children.textRawHtml:
This is my experience with all Microsoft software. The worst thought out, buggy, untested pile of crap.

There's something seriously wrong in Redmond.

At least with linux, you can search on the web and find a forum post telling you the magic incantation. With Microsoft, you will be forced to consume some second-rate engineer's unmanaged, barely workable, edge case until it might or might not work.

Office on the web is a horror show this way.
children.textZhHtml:
这是我使用所有 Microsoft 软件的经验。最糟糕的想法，有缺陷的，未经测试的一堆废话。

Redmond 出了一些严重的错误。

至少对于 Linux，你可以在网络上搜索并找到一个论坛帖子告诉你神奇的咒语。使用 Microsoft，您将被迫使用一些二流工程师的不受管理、几乎无法工作的边缘案例，直到它可能工作或可能无法工作。

网络上的 Office 就是这样的恐怖表演。

children.author: keiferski
children.textRawHtml: It is strange to me that people are re-discovering this today, in 2026. Microsoft has always been half-baked, even in the 80s and 90s. Heck, my parents basically raised me (20+ years ago) by running a business fixing problems with Microsoft products for their clients.
children.textZhHtml: 令我感到奇怪的是，人们在 2026 年的今天重新发现了这一点。微软总是半生不熟，即使在 80 年代和 90 年代也是如此。哎呀，我的父母（20 多年前）基本上是通过经营一家为客户解决 Microsoft 产品问题的企业来抚养我的。

children.author: michaelt
children.textRawHtml:
There were problems, but they were problems of a distinct and different kind.

Back in the early 1990s you'd get Microsoft Office from the store, as a box containing 10 floppy disks. And they had to put a lot of effort into testing it, because patching was impossible. And of course it was fully offline. Perpetually licensed, with paid upgrades.

The problems were instead things like "this notionally multi-user OS is just a single-user OS with a decorative login screen" and "any application can crash the entire OS" and "spreadsheets auto-run macro viruses" and things like that.
children.textZhHtml:
确实存在一些问题，但它们是一种截然不同的问题。

早在 20 世纪 90 年代初，您就可以从商店购买 Microsoft Office，它是一个装有 10 张软盘的盒子。他们必须投入大量精力来测试它，因为修补是不可能的。当然，它是完全离线的。永久许可，付费升级。

问题在于“这个理论上的多用户操作系统只是一个带有装饰性登录屏幕的单用户操作系统”和“任何应用程序都可能使整个操作系统崩溃”和“电子表格自动运行宏病毒”等等。

children.author: sumtechguy
children.textRawHtml: 'always online' has created a whole new set of buggy from a lot of companies.  For example cyberpunk is NOW a playable game.  Launch date was a very mixed bag.  'fix it after launch' ugh.
children.textZhHtml: “永远在线”已经为许多公司创造了一套全新的越野车。  例如，赛博朋克现在是一个可玩的游戏。  发布日期是一个非常复杂的情况。  “启动后修复它”呃。

children.author: mikrl
children.textRawHtml:
> cyberpunk is NOW a playable game

I never had problems with cyberpunk but I think I know why: I built a new PC right around its release and it was good enough to play it smoothly on 4K medium or HD ultra.

When I checked to see what 4K ultra looked like, the graphics latency caused a bunch of scripting to fall apart and the game glitched really bad.

IIRC the console release was notorious for bugs, so I assume consoles were not performant enough to run the game buttery smooth nor could they be easily upgraded.
children.textZhHtml:
> 赛博朋克现在是一款可玩的游戏

我在玩赛博朋克时从来没有遇到过问题，但我想我知道为什么：我在其发布前后构建了一台新电脑，它足够好，可以在 4K 媒体或高清 Ultra 上流畅地玩它。

当我检查 4K Ultra 的外观时，图形延迟导致一堆脚本崩溃，游戏出现了非常糟糕的故障。

IIRC 控制台发行版因错误而臭名昭著，因此我认为控制台的性能不足以流畅地运行游戏，也无法轻松升级。

children.author: robotnikman
children.textRawHtml: I encountered bugs when it first released even with a decent PC. IIRC there was a mission where you were running away in a truck, and it would crash every time at a certain point so I could never complete it. Also the whole save file size limit debacle, where they never actually removed deleted items from your inventory and the save file would reach a certain size that the game could no longer read (10mb or something like that)
children.textZhHtml: 即使在一台不错的电脑上，我在首次发布时也遇到了错误。 IIRC 有一个任务，你开着卡车逃跑，它每次都会在某个时刻崩溃，所以我永远无法完成它。此外，整个保存文件大小限制崩溃，他们从未真正从您的库存中删除已删除的项目，并且保存文件将达到游戏无法再读取的特定大小（10mb 或类似的大小）

children.author: wolvoleo
children.textRawHtml: I've played through the whole thing on the day one patch. On PC it was really not that bad. On console was another story though
children.textZhHtml: 我在第一个补丁的第一天就玩完了整个游戏。在 PC 上，情况确实没有那么糟糕。但在控制台上却是另一个故事

children.author: Wololooo
children.textRawHtml:
Cyberpunk was a dumpster fire on release, I'm not joking, you could have two machines seemingly identical but get wildly different performance, it was an absolute mess.

Even to this day after so many patches some bugs still are present.

The PS4 release was notoriously bad because they were reliant on caching from disk, if it's an SSD it's ok, if it's a hard drive, though luck...

This is even worse when you look at all the marketing material leading up to release, if you put that together it's close to fraud in my opinion...
children.textZhHtml:
《赛博朋克》在发布时就是一场垃圾箱大火，我不是在开玩笑，你可以拥有两台看似相同的机器，但性能却截然不同，这绝对是一团糟。

即使到今天，经过这么多补丁后，一些错误仍然存在。

PS4 版本是出了名的糟糕，因为它们依赖于磁盘缓存，如果是 SSD 就可以，如果是硬盘开车，尽管运气好......

当你查看发布前的所有营销材料时，情况会更糟，如果你把它们放在一起，我认为这接近于欺诈......

children.author: epistasis
children.textRawHtml: I was able to take a 25 year break from Microsoft, from 2000 to 2025. Yet I was drawn back in because my son wanted to play Minecraft. This was the worst account process of any system ever invented, as far as I can tell.  Plus in 2025 I had some interesting clients that are large corporations that use Microsoft as their core IT practice. The escape to the relative simplicity and consistency of AWS interfaces, from MS land, was the best part of the IT experience with that client. (With how much I've moaned and complained about AWS over the years, that last sentence is the most damning thing I can possibly say about Microsoft's products.)
children.textZhHtml: 从 2000 年到 2025 年，我可以从 Microsoft 休假 25 年。但我又因为我儿子想玩 Minecraft 而被拉回来。据我所知，这是有史以来发明的所有系统中最糟糕的帐户流程。  另外，到 2025 年，我遇到了一些有趣的客户，他们是使用 Microsoft 作为核心 IT 实践的大公司。从 MS 土地转向相对简单和一致的 AWS 界面是该客户 IT 体验中最好的部分。 （多年来我对 AWS 有多少抱怨和抱怨，最后一句话是我对微软产品所能说的最严厉的话。）

children.author: inigyou
children.textRawHtml:
Just pirate it. Minecraft is really easy to pirate if you don't want to play multiplayer, or want to play on pirate-compatible servers (which is one boolean flag in the official server configuration file and doesn't require a pirated server).

Make sure to get Java Edition. The other one is just an ad-riddden slopfest where they also ban you if you say swear words.
children.textZhHtml:
只是盗版而已。如果您不想玩多人游戏，或者想在兼容盗版的服务器上玩（这是官方服务器配置文件中的一个布尔标志，不需要盗版服务器），那么《我的世界》很容易被盗版。

确保获得 Java 版本。另一个只是一个充斥着广告的废话，如果你说脏话，他们也会禁止你。

children.textRawHtml:

Ended up on Minecraft Education on the computer, eventually.
children.textZhHtml:
不幸的是，该帐户的重点是多人游戏。想要一个锁定的帐户来与一群封闭的朋友一起玩游戏。

最终在计算机上使用了 Minecraft Education。

children.textRawHtml: Closed group of friends works fine in offline mode (pirate friendly mode).
children.textZhHtml: 封闭的朋友群在离线模式下工作正常（海盗友好模式）。

children.author: epistasis
children.textRawHtml:
If you can get a group of other parents to also pirate...

Not really in the cards, though I can appreciate your dedication to pirate advocacy.
children.textZhHtml:
如果您能让一群其他家长也参与盗版...

虽然不太可能，但我很欣赏您对盗版宣传的奉献精神。

children.author: ndriscoll
children.textRawHtml: The referenced config setting is apparently literally just whether to have the server authenticate accounts with Microsoft, so pirate and nonpirate players can play together on a server with checking off.
children.textZhHtml: 所引用的配置设置显然只是字面上是否让服务器向微软验证帐户，以便盗版和非盗版玩家可以在服务器上一起玩并勾选。

children.author: opan
children.textRawHtml: Can confirm, I ran a server like this at a LAN party once, 90% legitimate players and then a couple who hadn't bought the game. From what I recall they had fun and bought the game later. No auth means someone could put in your name and steal your items, and you probably won't have a (non-default) skin, though I think you can even work around those issues with mods.
children.textZhHtml: 可以确认的是，我曾经在 LAN 聚会上运行过这样的服务器，90% 是合法玩家，还有几个没有购买游戏的玩家。我记得他们玩得很开心，后来就买了游戏。没有身份验证意味着有人可以输入您的名字并窃取您的物品，并且您可能不会有（非默认）皮肤，尽管我认为您甚至可以通过 mods 解决这些问题。

children.author: somat
children.textRawHtml:
That is my plan, I have (had, you have to let it go) an old account from when it was a just username, never bothered "updating" it to the email account, I tried to convert when Microsoft said they were dumping all the old accounts, but the process was not working and I quickly decided I don't actually want a Microsoft account. At which point I decided that if I ever wanted to play again I would just do so sans account.

Which raises an interesting question, If I legally have a license for the game but they shut off the license servers, is it actually copyright infringement? (or piracy as people like to call it because copyright infringement sounds lame)
children.textZhHtml:
这就是我的计划，我拥有（拥有，你必须放弃它）一个旧帐户，当时它只是一个用户名，从来没有费心将其“更新”到电子邮件帐户，当微软说他们要转储所有旧帐户时，我尝试转换，但这个过程不起作用，我很快决定我实际上并不想要一个微软帐户。就在那时，我决定，如果我想再次玩游戏，我就不用帐户了。

这提出了一个有趣的问题，如果我合法拥有该游戏的许可证，但他们关闭了许可证服务器，这实际上是侵犯版权吗？ （或者人们喜欢称之为盗版，因为侵犯版权听起来很蹩脚）

children.author: inigyou
children.textRawHtml:
They will certainly argue, and win, by saying that for legal mumbo jumbo reasons, you only have permission to play it in the exact ways they say you can, and if you already bought the game, but they say you can't play, then it's illegal to play.

Which is why coming at this from a legal perspective a farce. Most of the world is like this, actually. You can assume that if some action brings money to large corporations then it's legal and if it takes away their actual or potential revenue then it's illegal. Go with what you feel is morally correct.
children.textZhHtml:
他们肯定会争论并获胜，他们会说，出于法律上的胡言乱语，你只能以他们所说的方式玩游戏，如果你已经购买了游戏，但他们说你不能玩，那么玩就是非法的。

这就是为什么从法律角度来看这是一场闹剧。其实世界上大部分地方都是这样的。您可以假设，如果某些行为给大公司带来了金钱，那么它就是合法的，如果它夺走了他们的实际或潜在收入，那么它就是非法的。遵循你认为道德正确的事情。

children.author: AngryData
children.textRawHtml: It isn't if you can afford enough lawyers to make microsoft's legal department blink at the cost of prosecution. If you can't drop $10K+ on a lawyer at the start though I would not put any money on winning.
children.textZhHtml: 如果你能请得起足够的律师，让微软的法律部门对起诉的费用视而不见，那就不是这样了。如果你不能一开始就花一万多美元请律师，尽管我不会在获胜上投入任何钱。
